title: StarCar yard snapshot - the wire contract
description: Spec 2026-07-23-yard-board S3: THE single owner of the server-to-browser wire shape (design rev 5 D15 - cross-language seam, schema-as-constructed-header). The Go server's structs and the browser's validator BOTH conform to this file; a hand-maintained mirror anywhere is a finding. Composition SEMANTICS (most-severe-wins, age quantisation) live in the spec and its vectors; this file owns SHAPE.

sseEventName.description: The SSE event name, exported here so server writer and client subscriber share ONE definition (design rev 5 section 5.4 item 4 - the one-character-apart failure mode is cross-language now). Tests on both sides assert against this constant.

register.description: The ONLY closed taxonomy (design rev 5 section 5.2). Severity order: nominal < in-progress < needs-attention. Growing this set is a constitution-level decision.

freshness.description: Closed by mechanism (design rev 5 section 5.2, amended #29 2026-07-26): an adapter is attached or not; if attached it has run or not; if run it succeeded or failed; if it succeeded but the data is old, something is IN FLIGHT and stalled (stale) or nothing is (idle) - a yard at rest is not stale.

ageBucketMs.description: QUANTISED server-issued age (design rule 3: the client never computes age). Included in change detection.
#29: same QUANTISED server-issued age mechanism as 'stale' - an idle yard still honestly discloses its age, calmly. Included in change detection, exactly like 'stale''s ageBucketMs.

oneOf.description: #29: data is older than stalenessMs, but NOTHING is in flight (every dispatch has returned or is presumed-lost, or there are no dispatch subjects at all) - a yard at rest, rendered calm/nominal, never confused with a broken pipeline ('stale', reserved for old data WHILE something is in flight and not moving).

dispatchSupersededItem.description: #69/#71 fix cycle round 2 (MINOR-R1-2): one entry in a superseded array - mirrors board/fold's DispatchSupersededItem (fold.go), which always emits both fields (fold.go's algorithm.go population sites), so this is a type-only tightening of a shape that has been well-formed on every real emission since #71 landed. Constrains type, never adds a new required field the server did not already always send - existing absent-array/omitted-superseded forms validate unchanged.

boardCondition.description: A fault about the BOARD, rendered in chrome, distinct from yard status (design rev 5 section 6).

recordDir.description: #69/#71 (clickable provenance, extending #28 to the board-conditions surface): the STORE-ROOT-RELATIVE directory of a record that carries this condition's own subject, when one is resolvable - same convention as trainsPayload's car.recordDir (board/assemble's recordDirBySubject, board/store's per-file rel-path fallback for pre-fold conditions), never re-derived client-side. Absent when the condition names no single store subject/record (a config-load fault, an aggregate count, or a vocabulary discovery - the last of which links to its schema/vocab/*.json file instead, client-side, never through this field).

position.description: A PositionDef id from vocabularies.positions - open vocabulary, registry-owned (D11).

data.$comment: Shapes for the v0 lanes are pinned by $defs.trainsPayload, $defs.gatesPayload, and $defs.dispatchesPayload below (spec YB-5) - each landed red-first by the schema car (plan task 2.2). An unrecognised lane's payload is a free object the view meets with the no-renderer path, never a validation failure (Law 7); these three $defs are not $ref'd here because a lane's data shape is chosen by which lane it is, not by one closed schema union.
data.description: The lane payload. Shapes for the v0 lanes are pinned by the spec's payload contracts (S4) and their vectors; an unrecognised lane's payload is a free object the view meets with the no-renderer path, never a validation failure (Law 7).

trainsPayload.description: YB-5: the trains lane's data shape. Each car entry joins the WINNING manifest's member declaration with that subject's fold output; declaredNotObserved names members with no records (design S6).

id.description: The whole train: subject - the train identity (design DR3-3; never stripped of its prefix for meaning).

gate.description: Present when role is gate: names WHICH gate.

recordDir.description: #28 (clickable provenance): this subject's record directory, RELATIVE TO THE STORE ROOT (e.g. "51-fix-car-r1") - single-sourced from store.Record.Path (board/assemble's recordDirBySubject), never re-derived from subject client-side. Combine with config.githubRepoUrl/githubRef/githubArtifactsPrefix to build a full tree link. Absent when no surviving record names this subject.

taskId.description: #75 (the human task-id handle, replacing the record-dir hash as the visible identity): this subject's shop-minted task-id, single-sourced from the winning RETURNED record's own task_id field (board/assemble's taskIDsBySubject), never re-derived client-side. Absent when this car has not yet returned with one (a dispatched-only car - #76's producer-side half is not yet landed - or a returned record predating #47's envelope echo); the view falls back honestly to rendering subject in that case (Law 1: never an invented handle).

declaredNotObserved.description: Manifest members with no matching store records (design S6).

tickets.description: #28 (clickable provenance): the manifest's own declared ticket refs (manifest.tickets, schema/starcar-manifest.schema.json), e.g. ["#28", "#12"] - never re-parsed from title prose. Absent/empty when the manifest declares none.

gatesPayload.description: YB-5: the gates lane's data shape.

outcome.description: VERBATIM - the gate's raw recorded outcome, never re-derived.

recordDir.description: #28 (clickable provenance): same convention as trainsPayload's car.recordDir - this gate's returned record's directory, relative to the store root.

findings.description: #12 (car health bar): the returned record's own findings field, VERBATIM free text. The view's findings.js module parses a conservative Major/Minor count out of it CLIENT-SIDE (unrecognised shapes render UNKNOWN, never a guessed count). Absent when this gate has no returned record yet.

dispatchesPayload.description: YB-5: the dispatches lane's data shape - mirrors the fold's dispatch entry shape (schema/vectors/fold/ owns that shape) plus assigned: boolean per entry (yard inventory = unassigned, rendered loudly).

budget_source.description: Car 4 fix, folded same-commit (docs/plans/2026-07-23-yard-board-plan.md task 4.2): board/fold's shop-default budget threading (spec Amendment 2, issue #22) added this field to fold.DispatchEntry AFTER this $def first landed (Car 2, task 2.2); this schema had no slot for it even though the fold has emitted it since Car 3. Present only alongside a non-null budget_seconds - 'record' or 'default', disclosing which patience produced the rendered state (never a phantom source for a null budget).

assigned.description: Yard inventory (unassigned) renders loudly, never silently.

recordDir.description: #28 (clickable provenance): same convention as trainsPayload's car.recordDir - this dispatch subject's record directory, relative to the store root.

taskId.description: #75 (the human task-id handle, replacing the record-dir hash as the row's visible title): same convention as trainsPayload's car.taskId - this dispatch subject's shop-minted task-id, single-sourced from its winning RETURNED record's own task_id field. Absent when this dispatch has not yet returned with one (#76's producer-side half is not yet landed) or when its returned record predates #47's envelope echo; the view falls back honestly to rendering subject in that case.

seq.description: Monotonic, assigned AFTER change detection (design rev 5 section 5.6 carry of rev 3 rules). The client applies a snapshot only if seq exceeds the last applied.

asOf.description: Most recent SUCCESSFUL store scan; null only if none has ever succeeded.

heartbeatMs.description: Travels here so the client never hardcodes it; two missed heartbeats flip the client to disconnected.

storePathDisplay.description: CWD-relative or home-collapsed - NEVER a raw absolute path (normalisation law; this repo publishes screenshots).

laneCount.description: Completeness guard 3: 'registry declares N lanes' renders in chrome.

demoMode.description: True exactly when serving a demo fixture store (spec YB-15). Sole consumer: the view's persistent DEMO banner - a disclosure. No truth surface may branch on this field (gating-matrix; the design retired demo-mode suppression).

githubRepoUrl.description: #28 (clickable provenance): the base GitHub repo URL (e.g. "https://github.com/polecatspeaks/StarCar"), or absent/empty when STARCAR_GITHUB_REPO is unconfigured - a non-GitHub yard degrades to zero provenance links, never a broken one (Law 7: no hardcoded repo identity).

githubRef.description: #28: the branch a record/tree link resolves against (STARCAR_GITHUB_REF, default "dev" - this repo's own working-integration branch).

githubArtifactsPrefix.description: #28: the configured store's path RELATIVE TO THE REPO ROOT (e.g. "artifacts"), or absent/empty when it could not be resolved. Combine as githubRepoUrl + "/tree/" + githubRef + "/" + githubArtifactsPrefix + "/" + a car/gate/dispatch entry's own recordDir to build its full GitHub tree link.

vocabularies.description: Presentational defs travel on EVERY snapshot so the view never hardcodes one and no separately fetched copy can drift (Law 6). Recognition VALUES stay owned by schema/vocab/*.json; these defs add label+register presentation. A value with no def renders by raw id through the detector path.

liveness.description: Defs for the fold's closed liveness states (dispatched/overdue/returned/presumed-lost) - the STATES are mechanism-closed; their presentation is still data.
